basic_info.description: This historic Victorian home, built in 1902, offers a perfect blend of old-world charm and modern comfort. Featuring three spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms, making it ideal for families or those seeking extra room, the beautifully remodeled interior boasts refinished wood floors, soaring ceilings, and an open-concept layout that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The kitchen is equipped with marble countertops, a gas range, and ample cabinetry. The primary suite includes an en-suite bathroom and a walk-in closet, providing a private retreat. Additional features include a dedicated laundry room, Solar Power (owned), a versatile storage/home office, and a quaint landscaped front yard. The landscaped backyard is a serene outdoor space, perfect for relaxation or gatherings. Enjoy partial downtown views from the front, adding to the home's allure. With a Walk Score of 96, you'll have everything you need right at your fingertips. This exceptional Victorian home is a rare find in the highly sought-after Bernal Heights neighborhood. Approved plans are available for expanding the home up to 2,200 square feet, offering potential for future growth.
